Conservative 1-step window; STUB until the first suggestion is emitted.

checks.name: Coupling adoption_ratio — touring vs raw-bash among Bash actions (D3, the mother metric)
checks.rationale: The mother coupling KPI (telemetry §9, F3): the prior-bash->prior-touring inversion. Among Bash invocations, the fraction that call `touring` vs raw-shell antipatterns (grep/cat/find/sed) — touring/(touring+antipattern) over the daemon lifetime. Unconditional (every Bash action), unlike F2's suggestion-gated uptake. gte 0.50 = touring is the default reach, not the exception (the prior has flipped). Baseline measured 2026-08-24: 4% of 4037 Bash calls used `touring run` (evidence/diag_gate.py, 55 sessions). gte 0.10 = the gates + repertoire moved real usage beyond the baseline. checks.name: Economia do code mode — programas que FUNDIRAM / programas rodados (P5b)
checks.rationale: A metade que faltava à `adoption_ratio` (achado de Gabriel, 26/08/2026). Adoção mede o CANAL — e sobe igual quando o modelo funde dez inspeções numa chamada e quando embrulha dez leituras triviais, porque `scan_class_of` não reconhece `touring run` e nenhum gate vê a rota sancionada. Este mede a ECONOMIA: `economical/followed`, onde `economical` é o programa que tocou ≥2 alvos ou executou ≥2 operações. Fala da APRESENTAÇÃO, não da disciplina do modelo: sob `code` a atômica é negada, então a casca sobre um alvo é obrigatória — economia baixa com adoção alta é o retrato de um braço obedecido e caro. STUB abaixo de ARM_MIN_SAMPLE tomadas.

checks.rationale: Task #6 compounding structure (the active hook layer): after the armed pillar-induction layer nudges a differential the upstream classifiers miss (master-cli or learning-memory), did the LLM's next same-session action take it (a master/recall command)? followed/emitted over the daemon lifetime, precise predicate. gte 0.50 = the master commands are reached for once nudged. checks.name: Explore rounds per convergence episode (mean, last episode)
checks.rationale: N2 (2026-09-23, recalibrado): mede o EPISÓDIO de convergência (cauda de rodadas após o último par seco), não a vida inteira do ledger — ledgers persistem entre sessões e cada re-exploração apensa rodadas, então rounds.len() cobrava re-visita como convergência lenta (mean 8.09 lifetime vs 2.33 por episódio, medido em 174 ledgers; p90 episódico 6 → limiar 6). A hipótese de cortar lente seca morreu na mesma data: economizaria 1 rodada em 174 ledgers; open_qs>0 em 0/63 ledgers longos. Acima de 6 por dias = lentes rendendo devagar de verdade ou alvo aberto.

checks.name: Política discrimina — estados multi-ação com dispersão de Q > 0.01
checks.rationale: P2 elos-exponenciais (29/08/2026): a QTable era um órgão quase write-only — treinada pelo trickle, pelo replay e pelo auto_learn (seco), consultada por ~nenhum decisor de produção (a doc do trait prometia 'using QTable' e a impl delega ao LinUCB). O consumidor já observado devolveu 0.990 constante para qualquer entrada (uma-execucao-nao-distingue-constante). Instrumentar ANTES de ligar a política a decisões (estratégia M0): fração dos estados multi-ação cuja dispersão max−min de Q supera 0.01, lida da learning_qtable do graph.db — a MESMA tabela que o replay treina (127 pares pós-backfill; eram 71). None/STUB sem estados multi-ação. Limiar 0.3 provisório: o veredito pede dias de sinal, não mais uma medição hoje.

checks.name: Corpus de outcomes recompensados já consumido pelo OnlineRL (replay offline)
checks.rationale: P2 replay (29/08/2026, pendência 'motor girando a seco'): o corpus de outcomes com reward (820 na estreia) nunca alcançava o OnlineRLEngine — o trickle online funciona (+1/tool call, provado 7→19→20), mas o acumulado ficava no memory.db sem consumidor e o estado do engine zerava a cada restart (13→7 medido). Numerador: replayed_total do cursor durável `learning_replay_cursor.json`; denominador: numerador + pendentes contados AGORA no memory.db (mesma fonte que `touring learning replay` lê). None/STUB enquanto nada foi replayado e o corpus está invisível — ausência é desconhecido, nunca zero. Abaixo de 0.9: rode `touring learning replay`.

checks.name: Memory entries reachable by ANN recall (indexed / stored)
checks.rationale: Entries absent from the ANN corpus are 4.3x more likely to never be recalled (measured 2026-08-02: 50.9% never-read outside the corpus vs 11.8% inside). This drifted to 0.797 for weeks with a one-command remedy — `touring memory reindex` — and nothing measured it, so nobody could see it. Below 0.95: run the reindex.

checks.name: Recall share landing on curated lessons, not auto-recorded outcomes
checks.rationale: Before the 2026-08-02 filter the eight most-recalled entries in the whole store were all `outcome:*:failure`, and automatic entries were retrieved 2.4x more often than curated lessons — the ACO pheromone diluted by its own exhaust. This is the anti-regression meter for that fix; a fall back below 0.5 means noise is crowding the channel again.

checks.name: Stored entries no recall has ever returned
checks.rationale: Dead weight in the store: written once, never read. 0.200 at 2026-08-02. Rising means either the corpus is drifting again (see corpus_coverage) or entries are being written in a shape recall cannot match.

checks.name: Curated nodes honouring the minimum graph contract (key shape + typed edge)
checks.rationale: P3 of the memory-graph contract (2026-08-30, Gabriel's directive via analise-e0): share of new semantic lesson/decision/diagnostico nodes (14-day window) with a deterministic <tipo>:<slug>:<date> key AND at least one typed memory_links edge. Measured reference corpus: 27/31 writers were islands. Advisory by the enforcement ladder — instrument before blocking; the store response's contract:{} advisory and the P2 structural rank make linking pay, this meter tells whether behaviour actually moved. STUB (null) when the window has no curated nodes.

checks.name: Typed edges created per new memory entry (14-day window)
checks.rationale: P5 of the memory-graph contract (2026-08-30): the ruler that decides whether `memory suggest-links` derived suggestions may ever graduate to automatic — only measured behaviour promotes an affordance up the ladder. Edges counted from memory_links, entries from memory_entries, both in the same 14-day window. STUB (null) when no entries were created in the window.

checks.name: Memory entries carrying faceted hashtags (hashtag library)
checks.rationale: The hashtag library only compounds when entries are faceted — an untagged entry is invisible to `#facet:value` filters and MOC communities. Backfilled to 1.0 on 2026-08-12 (7.393/7.393); every store path auto-tags since F1, so a fall below 0.9 means a write path is bypassing derivation (or the codetag sync silently broke).
